name: Ninon the Upside-Down Mermaid
source:
In the underwater kingdom of Cerebrite, there live several mermaid princesses. One of them is Ninon, who was born in a peculiar manner unlike the other merfolk: she had the head of a fish, and the legs of a human. As such, the other merfolk shun her, and she feels out of place amongst even her own family. 

Meanwhile, Ninon herself carries a desire to see the world beyond her home of the White Sea, a desire that is granted in a most unorthodox fashion on the night of her 21st birthday, in the form of a  chance encounter with a nobleman named Vivien Bellerose.

[From [url=https://madame-photon.itch.io/ninon-the-upside-down-mermaid]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在Cerebrite的水下王国里，住着几位人鱼公主。其中之一就是尼农，她的出生方式与其他人鱼不同：她有鱼头和人腿。因此，其他人鱼都回避她，她甚至在自己的家人中也感到格格不入。

与此同时，尼农本人也渴望看看家乡白海之外的世界，这一愿望在她21岁生日那天晚上以一种最非正统的方式实现了，即与一位名叫费维安·贝勒罗斯 (Vivien Bellerose) 的贵族的偶遇。

[来自[url=https://madame-photon.itch.io/ninon-the-upside-down-mermaid]itch.io[/url]]
